prompt: A clean, straight-on printed LIBRARY circulation ledger titled 'RIVERSIDE PUBLIC LIBRARY' (Circulation Ledger -- Card 4471). CRITICAL rule for each copy: its own transactions must alternate BORROW then RETURN then BORROW then RETURN, and their dates must strictly increase through that order (a copy cannot be borrowed again until it has been returned). The copy with call number 'QA76 .K52' is borrowed and returned twice; its four events (two borrows, two returns) must run borrow < return < borrow < return in date. Render it on plain white paper in portrait orientation with thin black ruled lines and a bold black header, like a clean office printout, photographed straight-on.
